information: publicView only; actual current-round preview for each of six assignments. No RNG state, seed-conditioned choice, future rolls, unopened inventory, or save replay.
map: Visible enemy HP, attack, pattern and available maintenance; middle column breaks otherwise equal choices.
arrangement: Deterministic pair-swap hill climb on adjacency synergy, first-entry reach and path-attack exposure. No dice have been rolled during this choice.
assignment: Weighted mean (80%) and worst (20%) of conditional public preview outcomes; death avoidance, enemy kills, friendly HP, damage and a uniform next-face geometric tie break.
acquisition: Static role scores adjusted for current roster; buys useful visible stock, fills empty places, replaces only on a full board.
healing: Use quick healing only for at least two actual HP recovery on a currently unpoisoned neighbor; accept one poison as the cost.
fusion: At least six surviving bodies, preserve a durable A and favor damaged B; skip when lost HP or adjacency outweighs combined effects.
retreat: Only when all complete current-round branches predict defeat, and a reachable empty tile exists; never retreat from bosses.
baseline: Same deterministic policy except assignment is always D1/D2/D3. Later state and choices may diverge; this is a policy comparison, not a fully matched causal experiment.
